title: Lexxxy Edited Cpvp
description: This is a CPvP texture pack that makes fire and anchor effects look nice, turns off explosion effects, and is FPS-friendly.
body:
Lexxxy Edited 16x is a Crystal PvP texture pack focused on performance, visibility, and a clean visual style. The pack is optimized to provide a smoother PvP experience while keeping textures simple and easy to recognize during intense fights.

The fire texture has been reduced to improve visibility in combat, making it easier to track opponents while burning. Anchor explosion effects have been removed to reduce visual clutter and help maintain focus during Crystal PvP encounters. Unnecessary particles and distracting elements have also been minimized to create a cleaner and more competitive experience.
